Fuels and Feeds
Farm & Country Needs
Let us be your trusted partner for all your farm & country needs!
FUEL DELIVERY
Fast, reliable delivery of diesel, gasoline, and kerosene.
FEED & SUPPLIES
Quality feed for livestock, pets, and wildlife.
EQUIPMENT SALES
Top brands like Cub Cadet and Bobcat are available now.
FERTILIZERS
Nutrient-rich fertilizers for healthier crops and soil.
GRAVEL & SAND
High-grade materials for construction and landscaping.
AGRICULTURE CHEMICALS
Eco-friendly solutions for weed, pest, and disease control.
Why Choose Us
We provide quality products and personalized service to meet your farm, home and business needs.
Experienced Team
Our knowledgeable staff offers expert guidance to help you make the right choices.
Trusted Brands
We offer high-quality products from renowned brands like Cub Cadet, Bobcat, and Purina
Local Service
As a local business, we're dedicated to serving our community with personalized care.
Convenient Delivery
We deliver fuel, feed, and more right to your farm or doorstep.

What Our Customers Say
I've been going to Jefferson Landmark in Bloomingdale, OH for some time. We get all of our food, plot seed, fertilizer, corn for feeders, and other farming items when we are in the area. Jeff is great with helping us go through our soil tests and decide on what fertilizer to use and how much agricultural lime to apply.
Chad Adams
Google Review
This is a great place for small engine parts. They are now the Cub cadet dealer, but what's great is their prices are very reasonable, even cheaper than the parts online. They're very patient and they go out of their way to help you with any problems you might have.
jostr s
Google Review
I have an oil furnace and always have fuel delivered by them. Every experience on the phone or in store has been great! Very friendly and knowledgable. They are always quick to deliver and the drivers are always so friendly and work fast. Have yet to have a bad experience with them!
Shawna Renae
Google Review
This place is absolutely great! I get everything from my corn for my deer feeders, to seed and fertilizer for my food plots! They are always so helpful with answering all my questions with food plots.
Amy Adams
